description:
iMOVE are delighted to present this exceptional three-bedroom mid-terrace residence to the Malahide market. Ideally positioned within the popular Waterside development, the property enjoys a particularly attractive outlook over a large open green and sports playing field.

The house has been well maintained throughout and offers bright, practical accommodation ideally suited to family living. Notable features include a spacious kitchen with quartz worktops and dining area, principal bedroom with ensuite, fitted wardrobes in all three bedrooms, an alarm system and a substantial walled rear garden extending to approximately 14.75 metres in length with raised decking area and shed.

The accommodation comprises an entrance hall, guest WC, living room and open-plan kitchen and dining area with direct access to the rear garden. Upstairs, there are three well-proportioned bedrooms, including a principal bedroom with ensuite, together with the main family bathroom.

Waterside is a highly convenient and well-established residential development located within easy reach of both Malahide and Swords. A frequent bus service operates from the entrance to the development, while Malahide DART and railway station is approximately five minutes away by car. Dublin Airport, the M1 and M50 motorways, Swords Pavilions, Airside Retail Park and the excellent shops, schools, restaurants and recreational amenities of Malahide are also readily accessible.

The combination of a large rear garden, open green outlook and convenient location makes this an excellent opportunity for families and first-time buyers alike.

Viewing is highly recommended.
